overview.description: The MFS Active Mid Cap ETF (MMID) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation through investments in US mid-cap companies. Security selection combines fundamental analysis with quantitative screening tools. MMID was launched on Sep 24, 2025 and is issued by MFS.
